title: Only Happens Here: 10 Traditions That Make No Sense Anywhere Else
description: Explore the unique rituals and long-standing traditions that define the Baylor experience, from running the field to enjoying Waco-born soda floats.

cards.title: The Baylor Line
cards.subtitle: Freshman Spirit Run
cards.notes: Join thousands of freshmen in gold jerseys as they run onto the field at McLane Stadium to create a human tunnel for the football team.
cards.short_summary: A 50-year-old tradition where freshmen run onto the football field before home games.
cards.evidence_claim: The Baylor Line was established in 1970 and consists of new students wearing jerseys with their graduation year who run onto the field at McLane Stadium.
cards.access_notes: Occurs before every home football game at McLane Stadium; participation is exclusive to freshmen.

cards.title: Dr Pepper Hour
cards.subtitle: Weekly Float Social
cards.notes: Head to the Barfield Drawing Room every Tuesday afternoon for free Dr Pepper floats and a break from the academic grind.
cards.short_summary: A weekly social event featuring free Dr Pepper floats, a tradition since 1953.
cards.evidence_claim: Dr Pepper Hour occurs every Tuesday from 3-4 p.m. in the Barfield Drawing Room, serving free Dr Pepper floats to the Baylor community.
cards.source_title: Happy 70th birthday, Dr Pepper Hour! - Baylor Proud
cards.access_notes: Held in the Bill Daniel Student Center (SUB) Barfield Drawing Room on Tuesdays during the semester.

cards.title: Diadeloso
cards.subtitle: The Day of the Bear
cards.notes: Take a break from classes for a full day of outdoor games, live music, and the signature tug-of-war competition on Fountain Mall.
cards.short_summary: An annual spring holiday where classes are canceled for a day of campus-wide festivities.
cards.evidence_claim: Diadeloso, meaning 'Day of the Bear,' began in 1932 as All-University Day to provide students a break from classes for fellowship and games.
cards.access_notes: Held annually on a Tuesday in the spring; classes are officially canceled for the day.

cards.title: Christmas on Fifth Street
cards.subtitle: Holiday Campus Celebration
cards.notes: Experience a live nativity with camels, horse-drawn carriages, and the KOT Christmas Tree lighting along the campus's main corridor.
cards.short_summary: A massive holiday festival featuring a tree lighting, live nativity, and seasonal activities.
cards.evidence_claim: Christmas on Fifth Street includes a live nativity, carriage rides, and the Kappa Omega Tau tree lighting, which began in 1967.
cards.source_title: What is Baylor's Christmas on 5th Street?
cards.access_notes: Annual event held in early December along 5th Street and Burleson Quad.

cards.title: The Immortal Ten
cards.subtitle: Memorial Tradition
cards.notes: Listen to the story of the 1927 basketball team during the Freshman Mass Meeting and visit the bronze monument in Traditions Plaza.
cards.short_summary: A solemn remembrance of ten students killed in a 1927 bus-train collision.
cards.evidence_claim: The Immortal Ten are honored annually during Homecoming Mass Meeting to remember the 10 students killed in a 1927 accident.
cards.access_notes: The monument is located in Traditions Plaza and is accessible to the public year-round.

cards.title: Homecoming Bonfire
cards.subtitle: Friday Night Blaze
cards.notes: Gather on Fountain Mall for the pep rally and the lighting of a massive bonfire built by the freshman class.
cards.short_summary: A central event of the nation's oldest homecoming, featuring a massive student-built fire.
cards.evidence_claim: The Homecoming bonfire has been a tradition since 1909 and is currently lit on Friday night of Homecoming week on Fountain Mall.
cards.source_title: Extravaganza, Pep Rally and Bonfire | Homecoming
cards.access_notes: Takes place late Friday night during Homecoming week; open to the public.

cards.entity_name: Bill and Eva Williams Bear Habitat
cards.title: The Bear Habitat
cards.subtitle: Home of the Mascots
cards.notes: Visit the on-campus home of Baylor's live bear mascots, Judge Indy and Judge Belle, who are cared for by the Chamber of Commerce.
cards.short_summary: A Class C zoo on campus housing the university's live North American Black Bear mascots.
cards.evidence_claim: Baylor has had live bear mascots since 1917, and they are currently housed in the Bill and Eva Williams Bear Habitat on campus.
cards.source_title: The Baylor Bear Habitat - Waco History
cards.access_notes: Located near the SUB; the habitat is viewable by the public daily.

cards.title: All-University Sing
cards.subtitle: Musical Showcase
cards.notes: Watch student organizations compete in elaborate 7-minute Broadway-style musical acts at Waco Hall every February.
cards.short_summary: A massive song-and-dance competition involving hundreds of students and professional production.
cards.evidence_claim: All-University Sing began in 1953 and features student groups performing choreographed musical acts in Waco Hall.
cards.access_notes: Performances held over two weekends in February; tickets are required and often sell out quickly.

cards.title: Steppin' Out
cards.subtitle: Day of Service
cards.notes: Join thousands of fellow students for a Saturday dedicated to community service projects across the city of Waco.
cards.short_summary: One of the largest student-led community service events in the country, held twice a year.
cards.evidence_claim: Steppin' Out is a 40-year-old tradition where thousands of students serve the Waco community twice a year.
cards.source_title: Steppin' Out Day of Service - Baylor Missions
cards.access_notes: Occurs one Saturday in the fall and one in the spring; registration is required for students.

cards.title: Ring Out
cards.subtitle: Passing of the Spirit
cards.notes: Observe the symbolic passing of the 'Baylor Spirit' from seniors to juniors in the Burleson Quadrangle before graduation.
cards.short_summary: A graduation-season ceremony where seniors pass leadership responsibilities to the junior class.
cards.evidence_claim: The Senior Ring Out ceremony began in 1927 and involves seniors passing a chain of ivy to juniors in the Quadrangle.
cards.access_notes: Held annually in the spring semester in the Burleson Quadrangle.
